item: Climate: NOAA ONI consented fetch (A1-2, fixtures only)
key_paths: src/stats/fetch.py; src/stats/oni.py; tests/test_oni_fetch.py; configs/external_artifacts.yml; docs/SECURITY.md; src/static/net-hosts.js
summary: fetch_oni: a consented, kill-switch-first fetch of NOAA CPC's oni.ascii.txt through the existing ONI parser, with a body bound derived from the table's shape (twelve seasons a year from 1950) and a loud refusal of an HTML page or an empty body rather than an empty series; gaps stay gaps; each fetch is a new vintage. Registry entry noaa-oni-table-shape; www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov on the SECURITY.md Climate row and the consent popup. Built on hand-made fixtures: the sandbox cannot reach the host, so the URL and table shape are documented, not verified live. Not yet shipped: store wiring, a route or button, the climate_events.yml check against the real table.
